committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 28 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid spend held steady at A$118.45 over the last 7 days (17 clicks, cpc A$6.97), and the landing-page test sits at 65 raw paid clicks with A$129.62 of the A$600 credit left. The A$7 cap and national settings stay fixed while the test runs.

No external Ads changes showed up in the last 24 hours or 7 days, so the account history is clean for now. Impression share is 10% with 75% lost to rank versus 18.5% lost to budget, confirming budget isn't the binding constraint while the test continues.

Since the test started, ask_cta_click (the question form) has fired 17 times against 65 raw paid clicks, but review_cta_click (the Cal.com booking) still sits at zero. The primary ask-first route is getting engagement the deeper booking step isn't yet.

AI Assistant sessions sit at 1 for the last 7 days (down from 2), with chatgpt.com the named source; remember this channel undercounts, many AI clicks land in Direct with no referrer. Organic Search also slid from 12 to 8 sessions, and total sessions fell 21% week on week (53 vs 67), so Organic remains the only unpaid signal worth trusting and it's heading the wrong way.

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding and need sorting.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match the current site stats.
